Property Care & Business Oversight

A local presence for what matters to you.

Stay connected to your property and operations in Kenya, wherever you are. We coordinate checks, household preparation, maintenance, and reporting for owners and investors who need reliable support on the ground.

Enquire about this service
THE KTC COLLECTION / YOUR LOCAL PRESENCE
THOUGHTFULLY COORDINATED

The details
we take care of.

Each request is tailored to your plans.
We agree the scope and quotation with you.

  • Caretaker, domestic staff, and labour sourcing, vetting, and payroll coordination
  • Pre-arrival home preparation, inventory audits, and deep-cleaning oversight
  • Maintenance logistics and contractor repair coordination
  • Expense tracking, invoice audits, and payroll disbursement coordination
  • Utility bill verification and meter checks
  • Coordination of tax filings and statutory returns with appointed professionals
  • Scheduled home, office, and warehouse inspections with photo or video walkthroughs
  • On-site security monitoring coordination and emergency call-out support

We agree reporting frequency, authorised spending, and the extent of representation before the service begins.
